_about: square_impact add-on (https://github.com/moexx399/square_impact). square_impact shows instant high-speed impact replays from the Square Omni launch monitor's own cameras, as an OBS browser-source overlay. This recipe updates it, starts its overlay server before the simulator, and waits for the overlay to answer - shown here with GSPro and Square Golf, both of which can use the Omni. Download square_impact.exe from the releases page and set its path below (the default expects it in a square_impact folder in your user profile).
title: Golf Simulator
subtitle: Choose a simulator to start

beforeEachSim._note: square_impact runs as several processes (a starter, the main program and worker processes); the kill step closes the whole tree and checks none are left.
beforeEachSim.label: Closing leftover sim apps

obs._note: In OBS, add a Browser Source with URL http://localhost:8765/ sized 1280x384 or 640x192 (1280x192 with --crop full). Each shot pops up, plays twice and disappears.
obs.label: Starting OBS

squareImpact._note: Replaces the exe with the latest GitHub release when there's a newer one (add --force to reinstall anyway). Minimized, and optional so being offline doesn't stop the boot.
squareImpact.label: Checking square_impact for updates

squareImpact._note: obs = run the overlay server. Options: --port (default 8765), --crop ball|full|left|right, --trim-front / --trim-back 0-1, --no-denoise. --no-update-check because the step above already did. conhost opens it in the classic console so the taskbar shows square_impact's own icon instead of Windows Terminal's.
squareImpact.label: Starting square_impact

squareImpact._note: The overlay server answers straight away, even before the Omni is plugged in; it then waits for the launch monitor's USB ports by itself.
squareImpact.label: Waiting for the impact overlay

steps.label: Updating if needed, then pressing Play
